Mira (People Ops): Quick heads up - Priya submitted a request for a temporary hybrid schedule (3 remote / 2 onsite) due to ongoing treatment. Wants this to overlap with the sprint and is worried about review timing. Adding @Jordan for manager context and next steps.

Jordan (Manager): Thanks - can you confirm what we need from a paperwork/process perspective? We're mid-sprint and a few tasks are on Priya's in-office days.

Mira (People Ops): We'll need a short medical note (high-level is fine), a proposed schedule, and a coverage plan. We can approve a provisional accommodation up to 8 weeks while we work through documentation. This is ADA-protected; keep details private.

Sam (People Ops): @Jordan I can send a one-page manager guidance and a template schedule. Q: can the team rearrange pairing/coverage for Priya's critical on-site responsibilities?

Alex (Eng): We can swap pairings. Priya usually does hardware checks Tues/Thurs - I can cover Thurs and take an extra Fri shift.

Jordan (Manager): That helps. Priya, are you OK with the swap? Also: will this accommodation affect calibration/perf notes? I don't want to unintentionally penalize them.

Priya (Employee): I can provide a note from my provider today. I'm fine with the swap. Appreciate the flexibility. :heart:

Mira (People Ops): Short answer: accommodations shouldn't be used against performance. For the review, document what support was provided and any impact on scope. I'll flag the accommodation context in calibration guidance so reviewers are aware.

hr-bot: Reminder - submit the accommodation request form and upload any medical note here: https://redwood.company/handbook/accommodations (secure portal).

Sam (People Ops): Manager checklist I'm dropping here (draft):
```
- start_date: YYYY-MM-DD
- provisional_end_date: YYYY-MM-DD (<= 8 weeks from start)
- accommodation_summary: high-level (no medical details)
- coverage_plan: who covers which days/tasks
- checkin_cadence: weekly 15m with manager
- review_notes: document adjustments in perf cycle
```

Sam (People Ops): I'll DM the template and create a private People Ops folder for the note. @Jordan once you confirm coverage and Priya uploads the note, we can put the provisional schedule in place same day.

Jordan (Manager): Sounds good. I'll confirm coverage and brief the team in standup. Thanks everyone.

Priya (Employee): Thanks all - will upload docs today and confirm the schedule.
